variants.name: 정돈된 네이비
variants.prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup / precise-object-edit.
Make ONE complete revised GAMEPLAY HUD screenshot at the same1920:800 ultra-wide ratio. Input1 is DIRECT EDIT TARGET, the recent actual CURRENT GAME capture. Input2 is only the previously preferred COMIC HUD STYLE for its character/equipment illustrations and visual personality; refine its wild brushwork/colors according to the latest user instruction.
USER CHANGE: A LITTLE MORE ORDERLY AND CALMER COLOR. Keep the comic identity but make the interface substantially tidier and quieter. Retain inked olive mech head/shoulder portrait and coherent handdrawn equipment icons; simplify panel edges to clean mildly clipped silhouettes with just1-2 restrained ink accents. Remove jagged red scratch borders, flying slashes, overshooting brushspikes and tilted baselines. Align text, gutters and keys to a consistent grid. Mostly MATTE dark blue-gray panels, warm offwhite lettering, subdued slate/sea-green equipment drawings. Red reserved for short ENEMY HEALTHBARS and a small selectedweapon marker; don't surround every panel with red. No electriccyan, fluorescentgreen or lemonyellow HUD. Calm readable green playerHP, muted warm-orange boost. No circuitry/chrome/screws or bland corporate icon-only UI. Icons remain rich chunky cel-ink drawings rather than generic tiny lineglyphs.
WORLD IS LOCKED TO INPUT1: retain exact current camera/framing, bright periwinkle tiled floor,02/circlepaintedmarkings, paneled block cover and tall facility power/service/coolant cabinets across top, peripheral DARK navy maintenance space and vents/pipes, physical PINK gates. Keep original olive mech at center-right,3visible white cube enemies, actual cyan partnerdrone at lower-right, original pose/rocket trails/explosions/smoke/debris/sparks. Do NOT globally desaturate/tint the game environment/effects or replace the current background with Input2. Change ONLY HUD overlays, restore scene under removed originalHUD. Remove original centerLOCKx3text; retain it as one small compact HUDcaption under missioninfo. No new characters/objects.
Current states: HEXBLADE health5/5 (all5life blocks filled calmgreen), BOOST (spell B O O S T clearly) as subordinate mutedorange bar,3lit energyticks ONLYinstatuspanel. ROOMS0/9 ENEMIES4 SCORE0 LOCKx3. GUN14/30. ROCKET0 graydisabled. Companion TRIAD FOLLOW, EMPTYsupport0/100 with dark unfilled bed; Q DOCK and X SHIELD disabledgray, Z CLEAN active mutedsea-green. Companion illustration should depict real round cyan mechanical casing/modules, NO digitalface/screen/eyes. The keys are Q, not G.
Six main compact equipment controls: SPACE DODGE, E RUSH, R ROCKET0 gray, RMB/T GUN14/30, L+R LASER, LMB SWORD. Small separate SHIFT BOOST caption. Consistent button sizes, uniform icon scales except a very small primarysword emphasis, even spacing, upright legible labels under icons, all controls safely insideframe. No healing spells/currencies/timers.
Exactly THREE short mutedcoral enemyhealthbars, same restrained visualtreatment, above actual cubes at x.42,y.20; x.24,y.47; x.215,y.28. Approx1cube width and8pxhigh at1940wide, dark emptytails/thinivoryedge. Illustrative80/60/40fills. Replace old tan healthbars, including oldtan line near x.23,y.391, NO duplicate. NEVER add a bar over friendlydrone nearx.855,y.65 or blocks/cabinets. Differentiate enemycoral vsplayergreen.
Composition: compact survivalpanel top-left with inked mechportrait within panel, missionreadout top-center, small neatlyframed minimap top-right, compact companionpanel bottom-left; actions bottom-right. Centralcombat kept visible. No external title/annotations/comparison/frame/watermark.

Variant1 ORDERED NAVY COMIC: closest continuation of the preferred comic look, clean understated deepnavy flat plates with barely irregular inkedges and one softly clipped corner. Warmivory medium-bold slightlyitalic header, uprightbody/keylabels. Mutedpetrol equipment icons with cream highlights, desaturated sage playerhealth, dustybrick-red enemyHP. Small olive mechportrait at top-left grounded inside panel with one dark inkstroke, not spillingout. Bottom-right six EQUAL clipped-square actiontiles in a rigorous3-by-2 grid, aligned rows, equal8pxgaps, uniform32pxkeycaptionline. Sword only singledout by narrow dustyredcorner tab, not gianticon/tile. SHIFTBOOST as a small short header above grid. Compact darknavy companionpanel with one clean emptyline and uniform Q/X/Z tabs. No brushbristles or painted diagonal underlines beyond one restrained identitymark at the logo. Matte, composed, still illustrated action-comic.
